mapper.sql: FROM sys_post post INNER JOIN sys_tenant tenant ON tenant.id = post.tenant_id AND tenant.tenant_status = 1 AND tenant.del_flag = 0 WHERE post.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND post.post_status = 1 AND post.del_flag = 0 AND (post.org_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_org org WHERE org.id = post.org_id AND org.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND org.org_status = 1 AND org.del_flag = 0 ))
